root_cause: pm12 holdings response turned empty positions into [{}] and classified position_source_count<=0 as MISSING_HOLDING_ROW even when the real RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore explicitly reported positions=[] and position_count=0.
fix: Explicit flat = positions is an empty list AND position_count is integer 0. Such runtimes emit no holding row and no MISSING_HOLDING_ROW, but still count in runtime/telemetry coverage and keep stale/degraded diagnostics; filters apply identically. Missing fields still yield MISSING_HOLDING_ROW / MISSING_TELEMETRY.
reproduction: Producer-shaped paper_fill_simulated -1 then +1 through RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore failed before the change (1 synthetic holding); hosted counterexample: holding_count 1, position_source_rows 0, MISSING_HOLDING_ROW.
